definitions.gloss: to pardon; to forgive; to absolve
definitions.explanation: To formally forgive sins, crimes, or serious offenses. More solemn and weighty than the general-purpose 許す, often carrying religious, legal, or literary overtones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すべて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{赦|ゆる}して⟦くださる→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧。
{死刑囚|しけいしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恩赦|おんしゃ}→恩赦：27213_onsha⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{赦|ゆる}された。
examples.english: The death row inmate was pardoned through an amnesty.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧、ようやく⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{赦|ゆる}すこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After a long time, she was finally able to forgive her past self.

notes:
A kanji variant of ゆるす that specifically conveys pardon and absolution of sins or serious offenses. While ⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧ is the general-purpose word for "to allow, to forgive, to permit," {赦|ゆる}す is reserved for the solemn, weighty act of forgiving wrongdoing.

KANJI DISTINCTION:
- ⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: general "to allow, to permit, to forgive" — the default spelling
- {赦|ゆる}す: specifically "to pardon, to absolve" — used for sins, crimes, and deep personal forgiveness

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{赦|ゆる}す: to forgive sins
- ⟦{恩赦|おんしゃ}→恩赦：27213_onsha⟧: amnesty, pardon (contains the same kanji)
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{赦|ゆる}す: to forgive oneself

REGISTER:
Literary, religious, and formal. Common in Christian texts, legal contexts, and literary prose. In everyday conversation, ⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧ covers all meanings.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: to allow, to permit, to forgive (general-purpose, much broader)
- ⟦{容赦|ようしゃ}→容赦：12288_yousha⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pardon, to show mercy (formal)
- {免|ゆる}す: to exempt, to release from obligation (another kanji variant)
